name: Out in the Field
summary: A watcher at Terral's Watch observes the plains for movements by the Horde. You are asked to get his status report.

sections.title: A Remote Watch
sections.body: A tower watches over the northern plains from Terral's Watch. Watcher Cornelius is stationed there alone to track movement among the Horde's forces. His post is remote, and he is known to speak little. You are asked to speak with him and bring back a status report.

faq.answer: Cornelius is the watcher stationed alone at Terral's Watch, where he observes the plains for movement by the Horde.
Terral's Watch is an observation post overlooking the northern plains, used to track movement by the Horde's forces.

faq.q: What report am I meant to get?
faq.answer: You are asked to speak with Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch and get a status report.
Cornelius is stationed alone at the remote watch post. He is known to be taciturn, and that is given as the reason for his assignment there.
